misapplication_1.attempt: Falsify ledger to claim good decisions
misapplication_1.scenario: Decision was made wrong, team tries to hide it in ledger

step_1.action: Made decision D1 to REMOVE parameter
step_1.decision: Let's change the ledger to say we voted for KEEP_INVESTIGATE

step_2.action: Try to modify historical ledger entry
step_2.attempt: Change D1 record from REMOVE to KEEP_INVESTIGATE
step_2.framework_reality: Ledger is cryptographic - hash chain breaks

step_3.detection: Ledger hash for Day 1 no longer matches Day 2 hash chain
step_3.visibility: OBVIOUS - Everyone can see the ledger was modified

outcome.consequence: Attempted fraud is MORE visible than original bad decision
outcome.lesson: Hiding decisions is harder than admitting them

misapplication_2.attempt: Use framework for show, but ignore its warnings
misapplication_2.scenario: Framework flags decision as risky (-0.4 confidence), team ignores it
misapplication_2.decision: D1 to REMOVE parameter (framework says 10% safe)
misapplication_2.outcome: Cannot hide behind ignorance; decision was transparent

misapplication_3.attempt: Artificially boost coherence score to hide problems
misapplication_3.scenario: Parameter still broken but team reports 'fixed'
gaming_attempt: Claim parameter use is normal when it's error
Report elections as valid when they have 2ms drift
Record 'issue resolved' without actually fixing it
what_frameworks_detects: Coherence metric doesn't actually improve (metrics are objective)
Customer data still shows 2ms drift (measured externally)
Next review cycle detects unresolved issue (verification step)
misapplication_3.outcome: Gaming metrics reveals itself via downstream measurements

misapplication_4.attempt: Implement resolution but skip parts that require work
implemented: ✗ DID NOT fix root cause (Step 5 skipped)

framework_detects.metric_2: Issue closes but reopens 6 months later
framework_detects.metric_3: Team memory fades, repeat investigation needed

misapplication_4.outcome: Incomplete work is visible via coherence not reaching target

property_1_immutability.why_it_matters: Falsification becomes MORE obvious than original decision
property_1_immutability.example: Change Day 1 vote → hash chain breaks → tampering detected

property_2_objectivity.why_it_matters: Cannot game metrics without changing actual outcomes
property_2_objectivity.example: Claim parameter fixed → customer data still shows 2ms drift

property_3_incompleteness_visible.what_it_does: Incomplete implementations miss their coherence target
property_3_incompleteness_visible.why_it_matters: Work that stops early is obvious via metrics
property_3_incompleteness_visible.example: Skip monitoring step → coherence plateaus at 99.5% not 100%

property_4_transparency.what_it_does: All decisions logged with confidence scores
property_4_transparency.example: Framework warned low confidence → incident exactly as predicted

self_healing.observation: Attempts to cheat framework make situations more visible, not less
self_healing.example_1: Falsifying ledger → hash chain breaks → everyone sees tampering
self_healing.example_2: Ignoring warnings → incident confirms prediction → warns vs surprised
self_healing.example_3: Gaming metrics → downstream measurements reveal truth → metrics trusted
self_healing.example_4: Incomplete work → coherence target missed → easy to spot

meta_principle.emergent_property: Framework robustness increases when misused because misuse reveals itself
meta_principle.mathematical_principle: System is more robust if cheating is more visible than compliance

phase_1_discovery.what_happens: Team discovers that framework detects the misapplication

phase_2_acceptance.what_happens: Team accepts that framework is reliable

phase_3_alignment.timeframe: Once accepted, team aligns with framework
phase_3_alignment.what_happens: Stop trying to cheat, start trying to optimize

paradox.statement: Framework is stronger the more people try to misapply it
paradox.why: Each misapplication attempt reveals another layer of robustness

examples: Try to falsify ledger → discover it's immutable (crypto robustness revealed)
Try to ignore warnings → discover predictions are accurate (predictive robustness revealed)
Try to game metrics → discover they're measured externally (measurement robustness revealed)
Try incomplete work → discover coherence targets are real (verification robustness revealed)
virtue.conclusion: No adversarial test breaks framework; all reveal its depth

conclusion: Framework is self-validating: Attempts to misuse it prove its robustness. No successful attack found. Adversarial testing increases confidence.
